'''Guru_Ketch A lousy profit''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Guru_Ketch]]
* '''Published:''' 20 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This...|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This...
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Profit Guru_Ketch LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A first pass at an objective deck (yes I have been out of the country)

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Ok, new and improved. I’m still missing some major players like some toys for my mains and Seeking an Audience. But for now I’m playing docking bays, Id like to add some fallen portals when I can get some. I may add some more characters and cut some dead weight in the interrupts section (You will take me to Jabba now is sorta pointless, but it can get Lando out and it’s a used 5). Whats a good method for greater force generation?

Thanks
